login.title: Sign in to AgentRe
login.userCodeLabel: Continue to device authorization after signing in
login.footer: By continuing, you agree to AgentRe's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

errors.oauth_state_invalid: The OAuth state has expired. Please start the sign-in again.
errors.oauth_exchange_failed: GitHub OAuth exchange failed. Retry later, or check the GitHub OAuth App settings.
errors.oauth_profile_failed: Could not fetch your GitHub profile.
errors.github_email_missing: Set a verified primary email in your GitHub settings, then try again.

entry.title: Enter the device code
entry.description: Your desktop app or terminal shows a 6-character code. Enter it here.
entry.footnote: No code on screen? Go back to the device and start authorization again.

errors.invalid: That code does not exist or has already been used. Check the 6-character code shown on the device.

approve.title: Allow this device to access your AgentRe account?
approve.risk: Once you approve it, this device gets full access to your AgentRe account as you, including running arbitrary code and commands. Only approve devices you trust.
approve.verify: Check that this code matches exactly what the device shows
approve.expiryAnnounce: This authorization request expires in about {{minutes}} minutes
approve.expiryAnnounceSoon: This authorization request expires in less than a minute
approve.fineprint: You can revoke this device's access at any time under Console → Devices.
approve.actionError: That did not go through. Please try again.

success.title: Device authorized
success.body: You can close this page now and continue on the device.
success.manageDevices: Go to the console to manage devices

expiredScreen.title: Authorization request expired
expiredScreen.body: Go back to the device, start authorization again, then enter the new code.

manage.title: Devices
manage.loadError: Could not load your devices. Please try again.
manage.revokeConfirmBody: This device can no longer refresh its credentials after you confirm. If it is offline right now, credentials already issued may still be accepted for their short validity window — revocation is not instant.
manage.revokeError: Could not revoke this device. Please try again.
manage.noProjectsReported: No projects reported from this device yet.
manage.noRunnableAgents: No agents can run on this device yet.
manage.detailLoadError: Could not load this device's details. Please try again.
manage.revokeCardBody: After you revoke it, this device can no longer refresh its credentials. If it is offline right now, credentials already issued may still be accepted for their short validity window — revocation fully takes effect the next time it comes online, and any running conversations will be interrupted.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This link may be broken, or the address is mistyped.

status.machineOfflineWithTime: This machine is offline — last seen {{time}}.
status.revoked: This browser has been revoked. Please sign in again.
status.loggedOut: You have been signed out. Please sign in again.

session.sendFailed: That message could not be sent. Your draft is kept — try again.
session.needsUpgrade: This machine is running an older agentred: conversations show reduced detail, and you cannot send new messages from here. Upgrade agentred on that machine to use it from the browser.

list.empty: No conversations on this machine yet.

decision.alreadyHandled: This request has already been handled.
decision.submitFailed: That decision could not be submitted. Nothing was sent — try again.

chat.title: Chat
chat.findMore: Go to the devices page to find more conversations
chat.startFirstBody: Pick an agent to get started. It works in the project directory you choose, and asks you before every step that needs permission.
chat.invalidBody: This conversation is no longer reachable.
chat.pickAgentHint: Pick an agent to start. Nothing runs until you send the first message.
chat.projectConfiguredHint: Where an agent lives is its own setting; the machine must also have this project's path configured before it can run.

chat.firstMessageHint: Nothing runs until you send the first message.

chat.r17Title: org / subagent / hook are not available here
chat.r17Body: These three built-in tools live on your desktop app. Web-launched conversations can't use them — start from the desktop app if you need them.
